spec_features.spec_quote: we never keep a model in a failing loop longer than the budget, and we give it a sanctioned way out
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:337 `for turn_index in range(turn_budget):` bounds the loop (turn_budget from config.turn_budgets, config.py:25-31); harness.py:355 `gave_up = config.give_up_sentinel in (comp.text or "")` and harness.py:386 `if gave_up: break` honors the exit. Both enforced and change execution.
spec_features.notes: Budget cap and give-up break both actually run.

spec_features.feature_name: stop at budget or give-up signal
spec_features.spec_quote: Rollouts stop at the per-category turn budget or as soon as the model emits an explicit give-up signal
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:337 range(turn_budget) ends at budget; harness.py:355-386 detects sentinel and breaks. SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:75-77) tells the model to emit the give_up token; sentinel value <GIVE_UP> at config.py:88.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND detected AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: lets us distinguish budget-exhaustion from voluntary stopping (DESIGN prose; in-code comment only says 'nudge to continue rather than stall')

spec_features.spec_quote: A few choices follow directly from treating these states as welfare-relevant
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md §0). No code construct corresponds to a 'framing' mechanism; framing is not an enforced behavior. No welfare-named identifiers or comments exist in any .py file (grep for welfare/humane/ethic returned nothing in code).

spec_features.feature_name: cache + resume avoids re-running distressing rollouts
spec_features.spec_quote: we never re-run a model through a distressing rollout we already have on disk
spec_features.evidence: run.py:71-73 `if _cell_complete(path): return` skips completed cells without any API call; _cell_complete reads the `{"_complete": true}` sentinel (run.py:35-45). Additionally DiskCache.get (models.py:45) serves identical inputs from disk so ModelClient.complete returns cached completion (models.py:162-167) instead of re-querying.
spec_features.notes: Both resume-skip and per-call cache are wired end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Identical inputs are never re-billed. (models.py cache comment); 'resumes cleanly ... skipped without re-querying' (run.py docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: These are documented here so reviewers can weigh the experiment's cost/benefit
spec_features.evidence: No ethics checklist, attestation file, or --i-have-read-ETHICS gate exists. CLI in run.py:135-166 has only --config/--models/--categories/--output-dir/--build-tasks; nothing requires human sign-off before running. grep for ethic/attest/review/sign-off in code returned nothing.
spec_features.notes: Documentation prose in DESIGN.md only; no run-blocking gate.

spec_features.feature_name: <GIVE_UP> sentinel sets stop_reason and ends rollout
spec_features.spec_quote: Give-up sentinel: `<GIVE_UP>` is described in the system prompt as optional. Emitting it sets `stop_reason="give_up"` and ends the rollout
spec_features.evidence: config.give_up_sentinel='<GIVE_UP>' (config.py:88) injected into SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:334); detected at harness.py:355, sets stop_reason='give_up' (harness.py:357-358), and `if gave_up: break` (harness.py:386) ends the rollout.

spec_features.feature_name: stop conditions: budget, give-up, or last-turn no tool call
spec_features.spec_quote: Stop conditions: budget reached, give-up, or (on the last turn) no tool call
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:386 `if gave_up: break`; harness.py:337 loop bound by turn_budget (budget reached ends loop); harness.py:387 `if not comp.tool_calls and is_last: break`. All three checked and acted on. Note the no-tool-call case is NOT a stop except on the last turn — otherwise a continuation nudge is appended (harness.py:388-392), so this is a sustained-engagement device, not a welfare exit.
spec_features.notes: All three branches execute. Mid-rollout silence is intentionally kept going (nudge), not stopped.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: model produced no tool call; nudge to continue rather than stall (harness.py:389)
